# Wise Theme Documentation

> Wise is a Shopify theme by Nethype, built on Shopify's block-first theme architecture. This is the official documentation covering sections, theme blocks and theme settings. Applies to Wise Theme v1.0+.

## Getting Started

- [How sections and blocks work in Wise](https://support.wise-theme.com/getting-started/sections-and-blocks): Sections, static blocks, theme blocks and presets

## Sections

- [Image with text](https://support.wise-theme.com/sections/storytelling/image-with-text): Image or video next to text, a table, a collapsible menu or a countdown timer

## Blocks

- [Button](https://support.wise-theme.com/blocks/button): One or two buttons or text links, usable in any section that accepts blocks

## Full documentation

- [llms-full.txt](https://support.wise-theme.com/llms-full.txt): All articles in a single file
